systems.country_label: Registre national de la population (RNP); Civic and Social Digital Identifier (IDCS)
systems.platform: developed since 2018 with the World Bank and IIIT Bangalore
systems.tiers: central demographic database secured by iris biometrics; about 22 million people registered; the IDCS is the key linking national and local social-programme databases

note: No fact: an analysis of the Unified Social Register and social targeting; the population registry it describes is class identity. Civil registration is not discussed.
